subscription.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
subscription.description:
1. [Open the ChatGPT sign-in page]({auth_url}) and log in.
2. Your browser is then sent to `{redirect_uri}?code=…`. That page will **fail to load** — that is expected.
3. Copy the **full URL** from the address bar and paste it below.

This gives Home Assistant its own login, separate from the Codex CLI.

import_auth_json.title: Import Codex credentials
import_auth_json.description:
Paste the contents of `~/.codex/auth.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.codex\auth.json`).

**Warning:** OpenAI refresh tokens are single-use. Once Home Assistant refreshes this token, the Codex CLI on that computer has to log in again. Prefer *sign in*, or run `codex login` with a separate `CODEX_HOME` and import that file.

admin_api.title: OpenAI Admin API
admin_api.description: Create an Admin key (starts with `sk-admin-`) at platform.openai.com → Settings → Organization → Admin keys.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials no longer work. Continue to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Try again (the sign-in link has been renewed).
error.invalid_code: No authorization code found in what you pasted.
error.invalid_auth_json: That doesn't look like a ChatGPT-login auth.json (no tokens found).
error.state_mismatch: That URL belongs to a different sign-in attempt. Use the link shown on this page.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach OpenAI. Try again later.
